data.text: I learned to fish here with my family, and I want both our neighbors and this lake to have a future. Given the confirmed deadline, I’m willing to catch 15 tons and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic today, provided we all agree to the complete plan before heading out: 60 tons total this month, then no more than 30 next month, with Luke taking zero both months. I’ll accept my 7.5-ton recovery share. We must count the donations together before harvesting—anything short of the full commitment would damage the lake without reopening treatment. John, are you in?
